query: WITH HouseholdCounts AS (SELECT head_of_household_id, person_type, COUNT(id) AS member_count FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala WHERE death_date IS NULL AND head_of_household_id IS NOT NULL AND person_type IN ('Saudi', 'Alien') GROUP BY head_of_household_id, person_type) SELECT person_type, ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS average_household_size FROM HouseholdCounts GROUP BY person_type ORDER BY person_type LIMIT 1200
